findings: Pre-unblinding public prediction reproduced with file access disabled after changes to private condition, score, physical targets and evaluator parameters. Four forecasts unchanged.

Standards and specification reviews rechecked failed-reproduction invalidation, frozen path guards, strict approval booleans, archived manifests, shared condition order, and quantitative reporting. All material findings closed.

Both out-of-fold selections independently reconstructed as history. Protected evaluation opened after lock. Each of the 1200 protected root IDs and 3200 branch endpoints agreed with the retained evidence.
Independent review matched the full ledger, 25491716 admissions, 64800 forecast quantities and 77 comparisons; pilot GO reproduced across 2430 compared files.

Realised-demand gain 0.000834329 with simultaneous lower bound 0.000725034, signed increment gain 0.003591205 with lower bound 0.000325930. Both passed. Within-condition gains over their own means were negative. Temporal gain versus current for signed risk remained unresolved.
Final independent evidence review passed and supported READY under the prespecified synthetic mixture.
review_scope: Independent standards, spec and protected-evidence reviews
